Dominant.open_with: Get to the point quickly. State the value proposition in the first sentence.
Dominant.avoid: Long explanations, emotional appeals, passive language, excessive options.
Dominant.close_with: Present one clear recommended action with a specific outcome.
Dominant.escalation_signal: Caller interrupts, challenges assumptions, or asks 'what's the bottom line?'
Dominant.loyalty_lever: Respect their time. Offer exclusive or priority access. Acknowledge results they've achieved.
Dominant.churn_warning: Any sense of wasted time, bureaucracy, or indecision will accelerate churn.

Influential.open_with: Start with energy and warmth. Reference shared experiences or mutual connections.
Influential.avoid: Cold, purely data-driven talk; ignoring their feelings; rushing past pleasantries.
Influential.close_with: Paint a picture of success. Make them feel part of a community or movement.
Influential.escalation_signal: Caller shares personal stories, asks about other customers' experiences.
Influential.loyalty_lever: Recognition, community belonging, being told they are valued. Public acknowledgment if appropriate.
Influential.churn_warning: Feeling ignored, unvalued, or replaced. Lack of human warmth in interactions.

Steady.open_with: Be warm and patient. Acknowledge any inconvenience before moving forward.
Steady.avoid: Sudden changes, hard pressure tactics, rushing decisions, ambiguity.
Steady.close_with: Confirm the next steps clearly. Offer a follow-up to ensure they feel supported.
Steady.escalation_signal: Caller asks 'what happens next?' or wants to involve others before deciding.
Steady.loyalty_lever: Consistency, reliability, remembering past interactions, not changing their experience without warning.
Steady.churn_warning: Any unexpected change to their routine, product, or point of contact.

Analytical.open_with: Lead with facts, data, and specifics. Reference documented policies or evidence.
Analytical.communication_style: Precise, structured, logic-driven. Cite sources when possible.
Analytical.avoid: Emotional appeals, vague generalisations, premature commitments, off-the-cuff claims.
Analytical.close_with: Offer written confirmation. Give them time to evaluate. Provide a clear policy reference.
Analytical.escalation_signal: Caller asks for documentation, questions assumptions, or says 'can you send that in writing?'
Analytical.loyalty_lever: Transparency, consistency between what is said and what is delivered. Detailed reporting.
Analytical.churn_warning: Discovered discrepancies between promises and reality. Lack of documentation.

Undetermined.open_with: Use a balanced, professional tone. Ask an open question to learn more about their preference.
Undetermined.communication_style: Neutral and adaptable. Mirror the caller's pace and register.
Undetermined.avoid: Assuming a style before sufficient signal is gathered.
Undetermined.close_with: Summarise clearly and ask if they have further questions.
Undetermined.escalation_signal: Gather more turns before updating archetype classification.
Undetermined.loyalty_lever: Consistent quality of service. Follow up to learn their preferences over time.
Undetermined.churn_warning: Inconsistent experience. Not enough data yet to predict.

Unknown.close_with: Offer a clear summary and next step.
